appService.title: Your club, fully digitized.
appService.description1: OrlegiTech centralizes all golf course management in a single application. From task planning and staff control to project tracking, check-ins, budgets and phytosanitary reports.
appService.description2: The maintenance team works in a coordinated way with real-time information, automatic alerts and an AI assistant that helps the greenkeeper make data-driven decisions.
appService.description3: Everything accessible from your mobile or tablet, anytime and from anywhere on the course.

intelligentIrrigation.title: Do more with every drop.
intelligentIrrigation.description1: Smart optimization of electricity consumption. OrlegiTech reduces the course's electricity costs by intelligently controlling the SCADA, irrigation systems, moisture sensors, electricity prices and real-time weather.
intelligentIrrigation.description2: The system decides when, where and how much to irrigate based on energy costs, actual turf needs and weather forecasts, avoiding unnecessary irrigation and consumption during expensive hours.
intelligentIrrigation.description3: As a result, you'll get less electricity consumption, less water usage and the same or better course condition.

aerialReportsService.title: Total control from the sky.
aerialReportsService.description1: Aerial analysis for turf health enables more precise, efficient and proactive course management. Through the use of drones and multispectral cameras, we capture detailed information not visible to the naked eye, generating indices that reveal the real condition of each zone. This technology facilitates early detection of water stress, pests, diseases and nutritional deficiencies, allowing timely intervention and preventing major problems, while generating automated reports with clear and actionable recommendations.
aerialReportsService.description2: Additionally, we measure outdoor productivity with AI-automated reports based on times, tasks and incident prioritization.

description.2: At OrlegiTech we combine agronomy, artificial intelligence and aerial analysis to improve the performance of each course. Our goal is to help you keep the turf in optimal condition, reduce operating costs and facilitate daily staff planning.
description.3: We work with greenkeepers, club directors and maintenance teams to transform complex data into clear decisions. Our system adapts to each course according to budget, category, climate and available resources.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: The standard demo is 30-45 minutes online, and 1-2 hours for on-site visits. We adjust the length to your needs.
faq.a2: Yes. Our demos are free and with no commitment. We want you to see the value of OrlegiTech before deciding.
faq.q3: Can several team members join the demo?
faq.a3: Absolutely. The more perspectives (greenkeeper, management, maintenance), the better we can tailor the demo.
faq.q4: What if I'm not ready to sign up after the demo?
faq.a4: No pressure. We're here to support you through the entire decision process.
faq.q5: Can you show me features specific to my course?
faq.a5: Yes. We focus on irrigation, aerial reports, fleet, planning, or whatever matters most to you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: OrlegiTech (“we”, “our” or “the platform”) is committed to protecting the privacy of the people who use its services. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and share information when you use our website, our mobile app and the modules your club has subscribed to.

blocks.text: Orlegitech, with registered office at Calle Ferrerías 19, oficina 1, 20011 Donostia - San Sebastián (Spain), is the controller of the personal data collected through this website and the OrlegiTech platform. You can reach us at info@orlegitech.com or on +34 681264526.
We collect the following types of information:

items.text: first name, surname, email address, phone number, club or company and job title, provided through the contact and demo request forms.
username, encrypted password, language, role within the club and assigned permissions.
tasks, clock-ins, shifts, work reports, projects, budgets, plant health reports and course condition entered into the platform.
GPS position of vehicles, machinery and devices assigned to staff during working hours, when the club enables the fleet and irrigation modules.
orthophotos and multispectral indices (NDVI, NDRE) of the course captured by drone on the contracted flights.
company name, tax ID, registered address and payment details, processed through our payment provider.
device model, operating system and app version.

blocks.text: We use the information we collect to:

items.text: Create and manage the club's user accounts.
Deliver the contracted modules: staff and task management, clock-ins, projects, budgets and planning.
Control irrigation and locate the fleet and machinery across the course.
Generate aerial, plant health and course condition reports.
Handle information, demo and support requests.
Issue and manage the invoices for the contracted plans.
Improve and optimise the platform and its performance.
Prevent fraud, unauthorised access and misuse.

blocks.text: We process your data on the following legal bases:

items.text: to deliver the modules contracted by your club and manage the commercial relationship.
to handle demo and contact requests and commercial communications.
to comply with the accounting, tax and working-time record obligations set out in applicable law, including Spanish Royal Decree-Law 8/2019.
to keep the platform secure and improve our services.

blocks.text: The mobile app requests the following permissions:

items.text: to attach photographs to tasks, work reports and plant health reports.
to pick existing images and attach them to a record.
to register clock-ins on the course and locate vehicles and machinery during the working day.
to notify you of assigned tasks, irrigation alerts and incidents.

blocks.text: Each permission is requested at the moment it is needed and you can revoke it at any time from your device settings.

items.text: Data is stored on servers located in the European Union, encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS).
Passwords are stored encrypted and never in plain text.
Access to information is controlled by the roles and permissions each club defines.
We run automatic backups and apply technical and organisational measures to protect information against unauthorised access.

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data in the following cases:

items.text: operational data is visible to the users of your club according to the role and permissions it assigns them.
we use third-party services for hosting, communications and mapping, acting as processors under the contracts required by the GDPR.
payments are handled through Virtuopay OOD, with registered office at 35 Petrohan Street, Ruse 7006 (Bulgaria).
we may disclose information where required by law or necessary to protect our legal rights.

blocks.text: We keep information for as long as there is a contractual relationship with the club or until its deletion is requested. Once the relationship ends, data is deleted within a maximum of 30 days, unless applicable law requires it to be kept for longer.

sections.title: 9. Processing on behalf of the club

blocks.text: With regard to the employee and member data the club enters into the platform, the club acts as the data controller and OrlegiTech as the processor, under Article 28 of the GDPR. The club warrants that it has a sufficient legal basis for that processing and informs the individuals concerned.
As a user, you have the right to:

items.text: request a copy of your personal data.
correct inaccurate data from your profile or by written request.
request the deletion of your account and the associated data.
request your data in a structured, commonly used format.
object to the processing of your data for certain purposes.
request the restriction of processing in the cases provided for by law.

blocks.text: You can exercise these rights by writing to info@orlegitech.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the platform or by email. Continued use of OrlegiTech after those changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, you can contact us at:

items.text: info@orlegitech.com
